whats_new:
A big update:
• Hear the recitation while you pick your verses, and tap a verse's number to play it.
• Your verses: every verse you've met in the app, lit across the whole Quran, ready to share.
• Share reels straight to your Instagram Story.
• Tanafus quizzes: share your result as a card, and challenge your friends.
• 26 fonts for the verse, glowing inks, your own colours, new frames and rounded corners.
• Verse numbers on your reels, and high-quality video.
• A My works tab that keeps your reels and cards together.
• Saving is more reliable, and a failed save can be reported in one tap.
• Many fixes and smaller touches.
